body.message:
Dear team, I hope you are doing well and staying safe!

We have new request for apartments in Dubai for the next season.
Please see below the request details:

DESTINATION: Dubai (family-friendly area)
DATES: November 2026 – mid-February 2027 (Dates are flexible)
BEDROOMS: minimum 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms
NUMBER OF GUESTS: 3 adults + 1 child (2 years old)
BUDGET: 35.000 - 55.000 AED per month
REQUIREMENTS: 
•  Fully furnished and suitable for long-term stay
•  Located in a family-friendly area with good infrastructure
•  Flexible and reasonable cancellation / amendment policy is essential (due to the current situation in  the Middle East)

Please let me know if you have any suitable units matching the above criteria.
I look forward to your suggestions and hope to collaborate on this request.
